page.overview:
Who is Clerk?

The Clerk is one of the bosses fought in Super Mario RPG: Legend of the Seven Stars. He works at Smithy's Factory, and is at the lowest rank of management there.

The Clerk fights Mario's party with five Mad Mallets. Like the Manager and the Director, the Clerk's axe has the same symbol as the Blade airship.
